dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Ah, friend, we meet once more.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Liben, where have you been raking in all that wealth lately?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Heh, I'm not exactly rolling in it like you think. Honestly, I might've even lost a few Mora.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I was recently doing business at the Collective of Plenty. Someone took a look at my mushrooms and said:

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: "Hmm... They look rather... ordinary. Not like those of the mushroom god's."

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: What in the world is a "mushroom god"? And is there some new variety of edible mushroom I should've known about?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: But I have to get home for the Lantern Rite whether there's money in my pocket or not. So, I've been running shorter trade routes recently — Dornman Port, for example.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: It's just north of Mondstadt. Have you not been there before, friend?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Well, someone was holding me back, telling me we'll "explore it later."

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: It's a port town built on cargo shipping and flower cultivation. Just looking at it makes you feel at ease.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: There used to be a very famous sanatorium up in the hills there, but it was torn down a few years ago.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: Speaking of which, it's actually kind of creepy. There's a pretty chilling saying about that sanatorium up in the hills...

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: They say that "anyone who visits the sanatorium will remain in those enchanted hills forever more."

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Because the place is so comfortable that there's no reason to leave...?

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: I guess it's not so creepy if you look at it that way. Maybe that saying started because of the fresh air up there, far from all the dust and noise below.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: Hmm, it must be nice to live in the hills.

response.speaker: Player
response.text: There are plenty of beautiful mountains and other scenic spots in Liyue too.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: That's very true. But, alone in the mountains, you can't help but worry about things like getting food and water or the risk of being dragged off by wild animals. Especially since no one's really set up the kinds of services needed for a proper retreat yet.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: It really has to be a proper retreat: pay to stay, get a nice rest, enjoy the opportunity to be close to nature. That's the only way one can feel truly comfortable.

response.speaker: Liben
response.text: In any case, I'd better get busy since staying at a sanatorium costs money. Looks like it's business as usual for us, then?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Ah, hello there. Need something?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here for my Box o' Marvels.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: The items needed today are as such.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I'm here for my Box o' Marvels.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I reckon you've already collected one for the day, friend! Still, feel free to inspect the other boxes. As before, you'll find that I'm no cheat.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you run me through your background again?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I'm Liben, and once upon a time, I sold curios.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: I'm working hard these days to save up for a nice long vacation.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What kind of business are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Simple. You find me a few basic everyday items, cooking ingredients and the like, and then you trade them with me for a Box o' Marvels, full of all kinds of nice little treasures.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Keep in mind that I've filled these Boxes o' Marvels with the fortune I made in my time as a seller of curios. There's no booby prizes to be found here, and I treat all my customers the same.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: Why box them up and turn it into a lucky draw, you ask?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: What can I say, people like a gift box. It just makes everyone a little more inclined to get involved.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: How do you earn any money like this?

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: They say that everyone in Snezhnaya is tightening their belts, so there should be a business opportunity there or two.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Goodbye.

dialogues.speaker: Liben
dialogues.text: See you around.
